results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: Management kept the ₹3,200 Cr FY27 revenue target (standalone). Standalone H1 was ₹1,268 Cr, so H2 needs about ₹1,930 Cr, roughly ₹900-960 Cr a quarter; the CFO said so on the call. Q3 usually starts lower than Q4, so we use ₹860 Cr consolidated.
The Changodar expansion starts only 'around Diwali' (November), so it adds little to Q3. The order book of ₹7,237 Cr is billable over 18-24 months.
Margin: Q2 standalone EBITDA was 16.1% against a 14.6% H1; consolidated operating margin has been 15-17%. Backward-integration gains start only in FY28.
risks: Execution has missed targets before: backward-integration plants slipped a quarter or two
Raw-material price spikes are mostly passed on through variation clauses but with a lag
caveat: Management's ₹3,200 Cr is a standalone number; Screener's consolidated revenue runs a little higher (H1 ₹1,311 Cr consolidated vs ₹1,268 Cr standalone).
